title: The Sediment Where Narrative Rests Undisturbed

features.name: the-buried-store
features.desc-on-touch: A shopfront pressed between soil-layers, its signage still legible. The goods it once held have become the stories the earth now keeps—names, transactions, the small economies of a town learning to exist.

features.name: the-stratified-archive
features.desc-on-touch: Layer upon layer, each stratum a year of stories compressed into thickness. You read them not as words but as the texture of sediment—weight of narrative, compressed into stone.

features.name: the-homestead-remembering
features.desc-on-touch: A small house, roof line still visible in cross-section. The earth has kept the memory of shelter, the shape of where someone chose to stay. The walls remember the weight of weather and choice.

features.name: the-wordless-record
features.desc-on-touch: Marks in the sediment too fine to read, too deliberate to be accident. The earth has kept records that the archive's own files cannot translate—the stories soil tells to soil.

inscription: the earth keeps stories by learning to lie still and very carefully remember
